import torch
from SentenceCompose import saved_sentence_values, fork_perception
p = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([.4, .7]))
o = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor([.3, .8]))
x = torch.tensor([.2, .6])
initial_p = p.detach().clone()
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD([p, o], lr=.05)
with saved_sentence_values((p, o)):
 cache = [(p*x).square()]
 for target in (torch.tensor([.1, .2]), torch.tensor([.3, .1])):
  trial, backward_perception = fork_perception(cache)
  error = cache[0].detach() * o.detach() - target
  expected_p = 2*error*o.detach()*2*initial_p*x.square()
  expected_o = 2*error*cache[0].detach()
  optimizer.zero_grad()
  (trial[0]*o-target).square().sum().backward()
  backward_perception()
  torch.testing.assert_close(p.grad, expected_p)
  torch.testing.assert_close(o.grad, expected_o)
  optimizer.step()
print('Both gradients match the analytic chain rule across optimizer updates.')
